description: Monitor an SFTP directory for new files.

host.label: Host
host.description: SFTP host. Required unless resource_key is set.

port.label: Port
port.description: SFTP port. Ignored when resource_key is set.

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var with SFTP username. Required unless resource_key is set.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var with SFTP password. Ignored when resource_key is set.

private_key_env_var.label: Private Key Env Var
private_key_env_var.description: Env var with path to SSH private key file. Ignored when resource_key is set.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Job to trigger when new files are detected

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional resource key registered by an SFTPResourceComponent. When set, the connection comes from that resource's own get_client() method instead of the inline host/username_env_var/password_env_var/private_key_env_var above.

name: SFTP Monitor
